results.testCase: TC-01: Login with valid credentials format
results.expected: Credentials satisfy email regex and min length 8

results.testCase: TC-02: Login with incorrect password
results.expected: Generic message: 'Incorrect email or password. Please check your credentials and try again.'
results.actual: Incorrect email or password. Please check your credentials and try again.

results.testCase: TC-03: Login with unregistered email
results.expected: Generic message: 'Incorrect email or password. Please check your credentials and try again.'
results.actual: Incorrect email or password. Please check your credentials and try again.

results.testCase: TC-04: Account enumeration prevention (generic error for non-existent users)
results.expected: Unregistered user and wrong password return identical generic error

results.testCase: TC-05: Login with empty email
results.expected: Empty email rejected before submission
results.actual: Explicit client-side empty email validation present

results.testCase: TC-06: Login with empty password
results.expected: Empty password rejected before submission
results.actual: Explicit client-side empty password validation present

results.testCase: TC-07: Login with both fields empty
results.expected: Submission blocked when both fields empty
results.actual: Submission successfully blocked on both fields

results.testCase: TC-08: Login with invalid email format (missing @)
results.expected: Invalid format rejected by email pattern

results.testCase: TC-09: Login with invalid email format (missing domain)
results.expected: Invalid format rejected by email pattern

results.testCase: TC-10: Login password min length check (less than 8 chars)
results.expected: Password under 8 characters flagged as short

results.testCase: TC-11: Password non-exposure in error messages
results.expected: Error message never echoes plain-text password

results.testCase: TC-12: Registration form required fields presence (Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password)
results.expected: Form contains Full Name, Email, Password, and Confirm Password fields
results.actual: All 4 required fields present in form

results.testCase: TC-13: Empty registration form submission
results.expected: Submission rejected when all registration fields are blank
results.actual: Rejected empty submission with specific error feedback

results.testCase: TC-14: Full Name whitespace-only rejection
results.expected: Names with only spaces rejected (min 2 trimmed chars)

results.testCase: TC-15: Registration invalid email format rejection
results.expected: Malformed email strings rejected by email pattern

results.testCase: TC-16: Registration weak password (< 8 chars) rejection
results.expected: Passwords under 8 chars rejected with 'Password is too weak. Please use at least 8 characters.'
results.actual: Password is too weak. Please use at least 8 characters.

results.testCase: TC-17: Password and confirm-password mismatch check
results.expected: Mismatched passwords rejected before submission with 'Passwords do not match. Please re-enter your confirm password.'
results.actual: Mismatched passwords rejected with mismatch error

results.testCase: TC-18: Duplicate email registration rejection
results.expected: Expected message: 'An account with this email already exists. Please log in instead.'
results.actual: An account with this email already exists. Please log in instead.

results.testCase: TC-19: Valid registration acceptance check
results.expected: Valid registration inputs pass all validation checks

results.testCase: TC-20: Checkout - Empty required delivery fields
results.expected: Empty address fields rejected with 'Please fill all delivery fields'

results.testCase: TC-21: Checkout - Invalid mobile phone (< 10 digits)
results.expected: Mobile number with 8 digits rejected with 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number'

results.testCase: TC-22: Checkout - Non-numeric characters in mobile phone
results.expected: Mobile number with letters rejected

results.testCase: TC-23: Checkout - Valid 10-digit mobile number with whitespace
results.expected: Accepted 10-digit mobile number after trimming whitespace

results.testCase: TC-24: Checkout - Invalid postal pincode (< 6 digits)
results.expected: 5-digit pincode rejected with 'Enter a valid 6-digit pincode'

results.testCase: TC-25: Checkout - Non-numeric postal pincode
results.expected: Pincode with letters rejected

results.testCase: TC-26: Checkout - Valid 6-digit numeric pincode
results.expected: 6-digit numeric pincode accepted

results.testCase: TC-27: Checkout - Empty cart order rejection
results.expected: Order placement blocked when cart is empty with 'Your cart is empty'

results.testCase: TC-28: Forgot Password - Client-side empty email validation check
results.expected: Explicit JS check prevents blank submission before network call

results.testCase: TC-29: Forgot Password - Client-side email format regex check
results.expected: Explicit JS email regex prevents malformed email submission

results.testCase: TC-30: Profile Page - Empty full name validation check

results.testCase: TC-32: Onboarding - Step 2 required skin type validation

results.testCase: TC-33: Skin Diary - Empty garment entry validation
